items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: because Kenny had this band with the French… the Belgian Francy Boland.

ctx.x: And I had met Annie Ross on the seashore, the seashore in Belgium with her aunt [inaudible] or something. And I’m sitting on the beach. And then, later on, because Kenny had this band with the French… the Belgian Francy Boland.
